subject: release of rstan 2.6.2 or 2.6.3 possible on mc-stan.org?

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: release of rstan 2.6.2 or 2.6.3 possible on mc-stan.org?
parts:
Hi!

Since I am affected by this ODE indexing bug which was fixed in 2.6.1, I was wondering if a release of rstan 2.6.2 or 2.6.3 (whatever) would be possible to do on mc-stan.org?

I know that rstan is supposed to hit CRAN any time, but it appears to be a very long wait by now; much longer than anticipated. Hence, if in the meantime a release on mc-stan is possible, that would be helpful (at least to me).

Best,
Sebastian

messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Re: release of rstan 2.6.2 or 2.6.3 possible on mc-stan.org?
parts:
I don't remember all the details but I've had good luck downloading the development (or tagged) versions of stan/rstan and just doing R CMD build/R CMD INSTALL to get them in.  You don't need to wait on a release.  Since the development branch has to pass all tests I've always found it usable anyway.

Krzysztof
